arguments.explanation: To calculate the total value of Technology sector holdings and its percentage of the total portfolio value for each portfolio, I need to join the portfolios, holdings, securities, and sectors tables. I will sum the (quantity * current_price) for Technology sector holdings and divide it by the sum of (quantity * current_price) for all holdings in each portfolio.
arguments.sql:
SELECT 
    p.portfolio_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.sector_id = (SELECT sector_id FROM sectors WHERE sector_name = 'Technology') THEN h.quantity * sec.current_price ELSE 0 END) AS technology_value,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN s.sector_id = (SELECT sector_id FROM sectors WHERE sector_name = 'Technology') THEN h.quantity * sec.current_price ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(h.quantity * sec.current_price)) AS technology_percentage
FROM portfolios p
JOIN holdings h ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id
JOIN securities sec ON h.security_id = sec.security_id
JOIN sectors s ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id
GROUP BY p.portfolio_id;
